result.title: Your scorecard
result.toleranceNote: This isn't a test, just a fun look. There are no right or wrong answers.

0.title: Red flags? Never heard of them.
0.line: Not a single red in nine cards. Either you're a born optimist or you've only met good people.

1.title: One alarm, and a very clear one.
1.line: You went red on just one card. You know exactly what you'll never accept.

2.title: Quiet radar, but awake.
2.line: Two reds: you forgive most things, but a few lines stay untouchable.

3.title: Three reds, still soft-hearted.
3.line: You have your lines, yet you give everyone a chance.

4.title: Right in the middle.
4.line: Four reds, five not. Neither naive nor suspicious, just about right.

5.title: Half suspicious.
5.line: Five of nine set off your alarm. Sharp radar, with a little room for tolerance.

6.title: Your alarm rings a lot.
6.line: Six reds: hardly anything slips past you.

7.title: Ultra-sensitive radar.
7.line: Seven reds! Even a tiny sign makes you stop.

8.title: Almost everything is an alarm.
8.line: Eight reds: either you're very experienced or some cards were truly heavy.

9.title: A full mine-sweeping squad.
9.line: All nine red! You didn't step on a single mine.
